overall_limitations: Computational review is not independent experimental replication.
Native source hash verification succeeded; confirmation is exposed for future users.

reliability.rationale: All frozen predictions and independent equal-die errors reproduce. Inverse-area confirmation MAE766.271ohm versus975.578constant; large failures and unresolved measurement gain prevent an intrinsic junction law.

mechanism.rationale: Computational agreement does not identify a microscopic mechanism; source constraints are explicit.

novelty.rationale: No independent exhaustive literature search or human novelty adjudication was performed.

significance.rationale: Useful as a bounded reproducible comparison or falsification under the declared information budget; broader value is not experimentally measured.

reproducibility.rationale: 27 recorded checks pass, including native preparation, independent group metrics and isolated standalone replay.

impact.rationale: No deployment, intervention or independent material/lot replication is supplied.

limitations: 19 dies on two wafers. Unknown acquisition gain/offset, nominal rather than measured area. Tail fits operationally define a response and may include defective junctions; all unambiguous devices retained.
Model-based review is not independent experimental replication or definitive novelty adjudication. All delivered targets are exposed.
Standalone predict assumes the shared evaluator validates arbitrary-submission domains; only the registered cohort was computationally reproduced.
